treaty_name: Convention between the Republic of Estonia and the Republic of Bulgaria for the avoidance of double taxation and the prevention of fiscal evasion with respect to taxes on income (2008)
eif_quote: Estonia MoF table (No. | Jurisdiction | Initialled | Signed | Ratified | In force from | Effective from | MLI effective from): 9. | Bulgaria | 26.10.2007 | 13.10.2008 | 10.12.2008 ( est/eng ) | 30.12.2008 | 01.01.2009 |

rates.quote: a) 0 per cent of the gross amount of the dividends if the beneficial owner is a company, which holds directly at least 10 per cent of the capital of the company paying the dividends; or
b) 5 per cent of the gross amount of the dividends in all other cases.
the tax so charged shall not exceed 5 per cent of the gross amount of the interest.
the tax so charged shall not exceed 5 per cent of the gross amount of the royalties.

ppt.quote: Estonia reserved MLI Art. 35(7)(a); its Art. 35(7)(b) notifications (25.11.2021, 01.06.2022) do not include this treaty, so the MLI (incl. PPT) has not yet effect.

notes: Interest taxable only in residence State (Art. 11(3)) when paid to Government/local authority/Central Bank, on loans granted/insured/guaranteed by them, in connection with credit sales of industrial/commercial/scientific equipment, or on any loan granted by a bank. Dividend 0% tier is drafted as a 0% cap (not exclusive wording). No protocol.
